description: Deck 3 of the legal loadout spec 09 saves. SPEC §8 cards #41-#60, disjoint from 09-deckbuilder-a and 09-deckbuilder-b (L4). See 09-deckbuilder-a for why the contents are arbitrary. Spec 09 also mutates a copy of this deck in memory to build its L4 case: one card of deck 1 replaces one card here, which puts that id in two decks of one loadout.
